status_policy.exact: Source and behavior reviewed against the named original declaration, with a MiniLang/native equivalent and regression or runtime evidence.
status_policy.technical-equivalent: Implementation is deliberately at the native/ABI/platform boundary or replaces assembly/pointer representation while preserving observable behavior.
status_policy.partial: Substantial behavior exists but not all original side effects/edge cases are proven.
status_policy.not-applicable: Declaration is outside the chosen GLQuake Win32 configuration or impossible/meaningless in MiniLang's runtime model.
status_policy.review-required: Present only as an inventory item/candidate; no exactness claim has been made.
